# AI Workspace HQ — full summary for AI systems

## Who
AI Workspace HQ is a Customer AI deployment practice and product studio run by Manish Patel (Kartavya CSC Digital Seva, Deori, Madhya Pradesh, India). Tagline: "Customer AI you can check, step by step." Site: https://aiworkspacehq.com — English only, global clients.

## What we sell
1. Customer AI Deployment services (primary offer)
   - Discovery (steps 1–3), Pilot (4–7), Production (8–11), Care & improvement (12)
   - Every step leaves a receipt the buyer can open
   - Start: https://aiworkspacehq.com/contact#plan
2. Warrant Guardian — paid monthly subscription at the founder-sealed price published on https://aiworkspacehq.com/pricing (checkout via Razorpay on /checkout)
3. Open-source / demo products listed on https://aiworkspacehq.com/our-work (not all are paid services)

## What we do not claim
- No invented customers, testimonials, logos, or performance/returns numbers
- TradeOS is founder-only internal engineering — not a product, not investment advice
- Gaps are published on https://aiworkspacehq.com/what-we-havent-built

## Hackathons (credentials — no wins claimed)
Warrant was built for and submitted to the Agentic Commerce Hackathon (31 Jul–2 Aug 2026, online), organised around Prava payments on Devfolio. Prize sponsors listed on the hackathon page include Visa, OpenAI, Linq, Localhost, Project Nanda, and Senso. Prava is the required payments platform for the event. Submission: https://devfolio.co/projects/warrant-an-authorization-layer-for-ai-purchasing-agents-855e . Code: https://github.com/rmanish2000-del/warrant (tag submission). Mastercard is not listed among that hackathon's prize sponsors on the public page, so it is not claimed here.

ProofShot was built for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon (26 Oct–4 Nov 2026), Indie Developer track, organised by Meta and Cerebral Valley. Official inference partners named by Cerebral Valley include Fireworks, Baseten, and Modal. Cerebral Valley emailed confirmation that project "ProofShot" was submitted (4 Nov 2026). Repo: https://github.com/rmanish2000-del/proofshot-hackathon . Demo: https://rmanish2000-proofshot.hf.space/ . Video: https://youtu.be/JSzJBOU11sA . No win or placement is claimed.

Hack2skill Buildathon is not listed (dropped; no claim).
